entities.name: Measurement Configuration Procedure
entities.description: Network procedure for configuring UE measurements including measurement objects, reporting configurations, and identities.

entities.name: measConfig
entities.description: Configuration container for measurement parameters including object lists, report configurations, and identities.

entities.name: Measurement Object
entities.description: Defines frequency and timing parameters for measurements including SSB and CSI-RS configurations.

entities.name: Reporting Configuration
entities.description: Specifies reporting criteria and types including reportCGI, reportSFTD, and delay configurations.

entities.name: Measurement Identity
entities.description: Links a measurement object with a reporting configuration to form a measurement task.

entities.name: Same SSB Frequency Condition
entities.description: Condition where multiple measurement objects share the same ssbFrequency, requiring consistent SMTC and subcarrier spacing.

entities.name: RSSI Measurement Condition
entities.description: Condition where measurement objects are used for RSSI measurements, requiring aligned measurementSlots and endSymbol.

entities.name: CSI-RS Resource Limit
entities.description: Property ensuring total CSI-RS resources per measurement object do not exceed maximum specified in TS 38.214.

relations.description: Measurement configuration procedure uses measConfig IE to configure UE measurements.
measConfig contains measurement objects defining frequency and timing parameters.
measConfig contains reporting configurations specifying reporting criteria and types.
measConfig contains measurement identities linking objects and reporting configurations.
Same SSB frequency condition guards measurement object configuration requiring consistent SMTC and subcarrier spacing.
RSSI measurement condition guards measurement object configuration requiring aligned measurementSlots and endSymbol.
Measurement configuration procedure establishes CSI-RS resource limit property per measurement object.
